shared_elements: animal figures in profile carved in relief on stone
repeated row of similar elements arranged in a register
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief profile creatures with pronounced bird-like heads and beaks, plus curvilinear motifs, rendered schematically with outlined bodies against a cut-back ground. But B organises its imagery into stacked horizontal registers with a row of repeated hooded/anthropomorphic figures above a band and quadrupeds and a long-necked bird below, while A is a scattered, non-registered composition dominated by a large crescent-and-hand-like form and a spiral, with no comparable register structure or figure relationships.
